title: Population: Distribution, Density, Growth and Composition

topics.title: Sources and distribution of population
topics.ncert_sections: Sources of Population Data; Distribution of Population

concepts.learning_objective: Recall how and since when population data are collected in India through the Census.
Describe the uneven spatial distribution of India's population among states.
Explain the physical, socio-economic and historical factors that shape population distribution.
State the meaning and spatial variation of population density in India.
Calculate and interpret physiological and agricultural densities.

topics.title: Growth of population and its measurement
topics.ncert_sections: Growth of Population; Population Doubling Time; Table 1.1

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish between natural and induced components of population growth.
Calculate and interpret decadal growth rates of population.
Identify the four phases of India's population growth and their causes.
Analyse the role of birth and death rates in the population explosion of 1951-1981.

topics.title: Regional variation in growth and the adolescent population
topics.ncert_sections: Regional Variation in Population Growth; adolescents; NYP-2014

concepts.learning_objective: Compare the population growth rates of different groups of states.
Explain the potential and vulnerabilities of India's adolescent and youth population and related policies.
Describe the distribution of rural population and the variation in village size.
Explain the growth and regional pattern of urban population in India.

topics.title: Linguistic and religious composition
topics.ncert_sections: Linguistic Composition; Linguistic Classification; Religious Composition

concepts.learning_objective: Describe India's linguistic diversity and the classification of languages into families.
Describe the spatial distribution of religious communities in India.

topics.title: Composition of working population
topics.ncert_sections: Composition of Working Population; Occupational Categories

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish between main workers, marginal workers and non-workers as defined by the Census.
Explain the spatial variation in work participation rate.
Interpret India's occupational structure and the sectoral shift of workers.
